description.en: Drepanaspis gemuendenensis has an extremely broad flattened armoured head shield and a small projecting tail. Thickness, tail-fin margins and colour are estimated; a raylike silhouette does not imply ray ancestry or paired ray fins.
description.zh: Drepanaspis gemuendenensis 具有极宽扁平的装甲头盾和小型突出尾部。体厚、尾鳍边缘及颜色为估计；鳐状轮廓不表示鳐类亲缘，也不表示具有鳐类成对鳍。

construction_notes: Use shallow domed shield with finite thickness, not zero-thickness plane.
Fossils show fragmented and displaced plates; do not reproduce breakage as decorative armor.
Tail fin and live surfaces remain conservative inferences; no feeding mechanism claim.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic representative envelope, not measured museum specimen.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block extremely broad flat raylike head shield and small projecting tail with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织极宽扁鳐状头盾与小型突出尾部；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: extremely broad flat raylike head shield and small projecting tail. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：极宽扁鳐状头盾与小型突出尾部。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

scientific_limits.en: Body thickness, complete tail-fin outline, mouth and eye soft-tissue details, posture, color and dimensions are estimates. Flattened fossil plates are not literal living surface cracks. Raylike describes the broad flat silhouette, not ray ancestry or paired ray fins.
scientific_limits.zh: 体厚、完整尾鳍轮廓、口眼软组织细节、姿态、颜色及尺寸均为估值。压扁化石的板块裂缝并非活体表面裂缝。鳐状仅描述宽扁轮廓，不表示鳐类亲缘或具有鳐类成对鳍。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original Drepanaspis gemuendenensis living stylization informed by museum fossil photographs, not a scan or exact fossil reconstruction.
shape_requirements: Preserve extremely broad flat raylike head shield and small projecting tail from original inventory.
Broad low shield dominates plan view; narrow posterior tail is subordinate rather than long whip or eel body.
Indicate major central and marginal armor plates with restrained raised seams, not a smooth manta-ray disk.
Keep jawless anterior mouth modest and eyes subtle; no hinged jaws, teeth or paired ray wings.
